tools.name: get_industry_data
tools.description: Get the published US federal statistics for any NAICS code, 2 to 6 digits: market size, employment, establishments, and for 2-4 digit codes also payroll and average annual wage, each with the exact source agency and the year it was published. Every response states whether the code is a single industry or an aggregate, so figures are never added across levels. Does not return growth rates, market concentration, forecasts or state-level figures. Read-only.

naics.description: NAICS code, 2 to 6 digits, e.g. "621111" or "5415"

tools.name: get_report_preview
tools.description: Get the free public preview for a VantaInsights industry report by NAICS code: headline federal stats (market size, employment, establishments), life-cycle stage, available tiers and what each includes, and a link to buy. Does not return any gated/paid report content. Read-only.

naics.description: NAICS code of the industry, e.g. "722511"

tools.name: get_sample_report
tools.description: Get VantaInsights free sample reports — full, real reports given away to show the exact format and depth a buyer receives. Two exist: a Basic sample (Janitorial Services) and a Standard sample (Solid Waste Collection). Returns the sample industries and a link to the samples page. Use when a user wants to preview what a report looks like, especially for an industry with no published report. The PDF downloads directly from that page with no account and no email required. Read-only.

tools.name: search_insights
tools.description: Search VantaInsights SEO insights articles (industry trends, profit margins, market-size explainers) by keyword, theme, or 2-digit NAICS sector. Returns matching article titles, a headline stat, and links. Read-only.

query.description: Keyword to match against article title and keywords

tools.name: search_naics
tools.description: Resolve a US industry to its NAICS code by keyword or code, across the FULL NAICS taxonomy (not just published reports). Each match flags whether VantaInsights already has a published report (link to its free preview) or not (link to request a custom report). Use this first to turn an industry name into a code. Read-only.

query.description: Industry keyword or NAICS code, e.g. "restaurants" or "7225"

tools.name: search_reports
tools.description: Search the VantaInsights marketplace of US industry research reports by NAICS code or industry keyword. Returns matching reports with their NAICS code, available tiers, price, headline federal stats (market size, employment, establishments) and a link. Read-only.

query.description: NAICS code or industry keyword, e.g. "722511" or "restaurants"

sector.description: Optional 2-digit NAICS sector code to filter by
